headline: Kenneth Ganna Conteh shows how civil society groups came together to keep Sierra Leone's elections free, fair and credible. This version keeps the approved V4 cut and adds French subtitles next to the English.
story: Kenneth leads Search for Common Ground in South Sudan. After the war in Sierra Leone he chaired National Election Watch, a coalition of civil society groups. He teaches what he learned: a shared goal, an observer in every polling station, trust, and credibility. He ends proud and hopeful.

The cut is done and Rachel approved this style for the series. This pass is subtitles only: every English line keeps its place, and a French line is added for the French-speaking audience. No picture or sound change.
